description: Fix an Angular project that fails during install, compile or production build, then document the root cause.
requirements: Repository should contain an Angular project with a clear build fix commit or pull request
Angular build command such as npm run build or ng build should complete successfully
Fix should address the real cause such as TypeScript errors, missing imports, dependency mismatch, template errors or configuration issues
Existing application behavior should remain intact after the build fix
README.md, issue note or commit message should explain the build failure and the fix
title: Fix Angular Project Build Failure
